info.title: Special education disputes by state (IDEA Part B): complaints, mediation and due process, school years 2012-13 to 2023-24: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Special education disputes by state (IDEA Part B): complaints, mediation and due process, school years 2012-13 to 2023-24: The U.S. Department of Education's counts of special education disputes under IDEA Part B for the nation, every state, DC and five territories, by school year: written state complaints, mediation requests and mediations held, due process complaints, resolution meetings, hearings and complaints withdrawn or dismissed.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
